purpose: Higgsfield 72h trial: build a permanent Pusnik G clip library (Vice-City look without Rockstar IP)
rules: full prompt = item.prompt + ' ' + style[kind] (music: prompt as is)
no text, logos, badges, plates, real people or game characters
prefer the model in model_hint, else best available
an id listed in assets/ai_library.json or assets/ai_queue.json is done - skip it

style.video: Vertical 9:16, photorealistic cinematic footage, smooth stabilized camera motion, vivid teal-and-magenta Miami-style color grade, high detail, natural motion. No text, no captions, no logos, no brand badges, no license plates, no watermarks, no recognizable real people or game characters.
style.image: Vertical 9:16 still image, photorealistic, cinematic lighting, vivid teal-and-magenta grade, lots of empty space in the upper third for big title text. No text, no logos, no brand badges, no watermarks, no recognizable real people or game characters.
